name: Andrew Hussie
source:
The author's self-insert, who claims to be an omnipotent conjurer but, in reality, can't actually do anything at all besides ramble into the narrative.

The author is nonbinary in real life, using any pronouns, but since Homestuck was completed before she came out, the character Andrew Hussie uses he/him.

[spoiler]During Act 6, he acts as an exile stand-in for Caliborn's impossible solo session.[/spoiler]

Andrew briefly appears in Beyond Canon, in the bonus scenario "A Threat, Sensed."
